query.statement: SELECT PLANT_ID, PLANT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, COUNTRY, TIME_ZONE FROM MDM_PLANT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY PLANT_NAME

SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, EQUIPMENT_NAME, PLANT_ID, AREA_ID, EQUIPMENT_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID, VALID_STATE FROM MDM_EQUIPMENT WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND (@validState IS NULL OR VALID_STATE = @validState) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID

INSERT INTO MDM_PLANT (PLANT_ID, PLANT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, COUNTRY, TIME_ZONE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@plantId, @plantName, @description, @country, @timeZone, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)
SELECT PLANT_ID, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY FROM MDM_PLANT WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId
